annotations.title: Connections around a company, site, state or record

description: Return the part of the Seraphix graph around one node: the companies, corporate parents and subsidiaries, data-center sites, states, records and SEC filings linked to it, up to depth 3 (at most 200 nodes). Every edge names its source (via) and date; record nodes carry the verbatim quote and source_url. Node ids look like org:SXE-…, site:…, place:TX, rec:SX-07-A-0001, filing:<accession>; a company name or SEC CIK also works. explore_url opens the same view for a person.

depth.description: How many links out from the node (1-3, default 1).

node.description: Company name, SEC CIK, or a node id such as place:TX or rec:SX-07-A-0001.

name: graph_neighborhood

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Records: cite each by its record_url.
